missing: Which travel two-screen extenders actually run on a one-monitor MacBook Air (M1/M2, M3 lid-open) using display-driver software like DisplayLink or a matching dock, versus M4/M5 Airs that drive two natively. The page should give the setup steps, current prices and a direct pick.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this exact question with testing. Tom's Guide and TechRadar are off-target. Macworld lists a two-screen extender without addressing the Air's limit. iMore only warns that its pick won't work on an Air. Apple explains the limits but recommends nothing. The rest are generic affiliate roundups and one lightly scored niche page. A focused page sorted by Air model, with a clear workaround, prices and a pick would stand out.
